songs.title: My Luva
songs.verdict: A smooth, unhurried love song from a Hawthorne R&B singer warming people up for his next EP.
songs.body:
SleezeTeamJason (Shawn Jackson) is an R&B artist from Hawthorne, California.
His My L.O.V.E. EP is due Nov 20; this is the lead-in.
songs.scout_note: Remixd Magazine 'From Our Submissions' pick, New Music Friday Nov 6 (remixdmagazine.com/new-music-friday-week-of-november-6/). Small independent artist; listener count not checked.

songs.title: Disturbia (feat. Thuqga Lucifer)
songs.verdict: Dark, melodic emo rap with a gothic-rock shadow over it, straight out of Miami Gardens.
songs.body:
XRITUAL is a Miami Gardens, Florida artist blending emo rap and gothic rock.
Released Nov 1 with Thuqga Lucifer on the feature.
songs.scout_note: South Florida artist (local angle for @wackometer and the QR stickers). Remixd Magazine 'In Case You Missed It', Nov 6 roundup. Spotify link is the single's release page.

songs.title: BURNT PAGES
songs.verdict: A 10-track Queens rap album about loss and perseverance, backed by a deep bench of New York features.
songs.body:
STORY is a rapper from Queens, New York.
Guests include Dusty Locane, Millyz, Kocky Ka, Top Gee, Cosi Pari and BigBaby Juss.
songs.scout_note: Released Oct 28. Remixd Magazine 'In Case You Missed It', Nov 6 roundup. Album: pick a standout track in the review.

songs.title: Make them Wonder
songs.verdict: A confident single from a Nigerian-American singer-songwriter that slides between R&B, Afropop and dance.
songs.body:
OWO is a Nigerian-American singer-songwriter.
The single mixes R&B, Afropop, pop and dance.
songs.scout_note: Released Oct 16. Remixd Magazine 'In Case You Missed It', Nov 6 roundup. Spotify link is the single's release page.

songs.title: Limbo¿
songs.verdict: Pumping bass and a jazz-tinged piano-synth line under a vocal that drifts between singing and rapping.
songs.body:
i.B. Dollface is a Canadian singer working between electro-pop and alternative R&B.
The song leans on rap-style phrasing over upbeat, bass-forward production.
songs.scout_note: Covered by Uranium Waves (Canadian discovery blog), Nov 8. Release date not stated; covered this week. Small artist.

songs.title: Entropy
songs.verdict: A Guelph band pulling soul, jazz and funk into alt R&B, driven by syncopated guitar and a busy bassline.
songs.body:
SHEBAD is a band from Guelph, Ontario rooted in soul, jazz, fusion and funk.
Entropy is built on syncopated riffs, layered harmonies and live drums.
songs.scout_note: Uranium Waves feature, Nov 3. Small independent band.

songs.title: Here I Am
songs.verdict: A gritty, left-of-center rap record mixing Southern bounce, boom bap and dark atmosphere.
songs.body:
Ezza of Choom Gang is a Canadian rapper; this is his ninth solo album (13 tracks).
Features include Yung Next, AYOO BIGZ, BOOGIE MASON and Wingman777.
songs.scout_note: Uranium Waves album review, Nov 4. Underground, self-directed. Album: pick a standout track in the review.

songs.title: Machine
songs.verdict: Off-kilter guitars and a tight, mechanical beat behind a cool, sultry vocal, with a punk edge.
songs.body:
colby! is an American indie and alt-pop artist.
Machine is upbeat and groove-first, with punk-leaning guitar figures.
songs.scout_note: Uranium Waves feature, Nov 8. Small artist.

songs.title: Running Away
songs.verdict: Driving Italian indie pop about late-night drives and a love triangle that wears you out.
songs.body:
Matilde G is an Italian indie-pop singer.
Upbeat drums and electric guitar push against a controlled, yearning vocal.
songs.scout_note: Uranium Waves feature, Nov 8. Small artist.

songs.title: Sucker Punch
songs.verdict: Weathered, lo-fi indie folk-pop that builds tension by repeating rather than exploding.
songs.body:
Kaitlyn Fox is an American indie folk-pop singer.
Gentle guitars and lo-fi drums sit under a slightly rough, sultry vocal.
songs.scout_note: Uranium Waves feature, Nov 2. Small artist.

songs.title: withforwardmotion
songs.verdict: Grunge-heavy shoegaze that borrows weight from hardcore and nü metal: dense guitars and real breakdowns.
songs.body:
Day Aches are from the Virginia / Washington, D.C. area.
Their second album (10 songs) is out on Other People Records; singles were In Water and outerheaven.
songs.scout_note: Released Nov 4 (Release Wave November list). Links are to the artist pages; no album-specific link found, so the desk has no built-in player. Open Bandcamp to listen.

songs.title: Where Could I Go?
songs.verdict: Direct, emotional Atlanta punk with big melodic hooks, in the line of The Weakerthans and Green Day.
songs.body:
New Junk City are an Atlanta punk band formed in 2013; this is their fourth album, out on Lauren Records.
Twelve songs about love, grief and compromise; lead single Lonely Now.
songs.scout_note: Released Nov 6 (Release Wave November list). Artist-page links only. Check they're under the underground cutoff before publishing.

songs.title: A Portrait of Fear
songs.verdict: Ten tracks of 90s-style alt rock, grunge and shoegaze with Americana creeping in at the edges.
songs.body:
Melodic Canvas is the project of Northern Michigan musician and visual artist Evan Alderton, formed in 2016.
Third LP after Sterile (2021) and Discoloration (2024); 2026 singles include Limn, Shacket and Dust.
songs.scout_note: Released Nov 4 on Setterwind / Candlepin Records (Release Wave). Artist-page links only.

songs.title: High Horse
songs.verdict: A debut of laid-back slacker rock with emo guitar lines and punk bite, treating everyday annoyances as comedy.
songs.body:
FFO: Chillin are a four-piece from Concord, New Hampshire.
High Horse is their first full-length (nine songs) on DAZE; latest single Fresh Start.
songs.scout_note: Released Nov 6 (Release Wave November list). Debut album, small band.

songs.title: Vacas Flacas
songs.verdict: A Medellín rapper's solo project that mixes street rap with salsa and Caribbean rhythms.
songs.body:
Kapla is from Medellín, Colombia, formerly half of the duo Kapla y Miky.
This solo project blends rap with salsa and Caribbean grooves.
songs.scout_note: Remixd Magazine 'From Our Submissions', Nov 6 roundup. Heads up: the old duo may have had a big following, so check his listener count; if he's over the cutoff, tick Big One or skip.
